description: Implementation of AudioFrameTracker class managing audio frame timing and playback rate adjustments.

classes.name: AudioFrameTracker
classes.description: Tracks audio frames and playback rate adjustments for synchronization.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the frame records and playback adjustment counter.

methods.name: AddFrames
methods.description: Adds a number of frames with a specified playback rate to the tracker.

methods.name: RecordPlayedFrames
methods.description: Records the number of frames that have been played, adjusting internal counters.

methods.name: GetFutureFramesPlayedAdjustedToPlaybackRate
methods.description: Calculates the total frames that will be played adjusted to playback rate, given a number of frames.
